sources.title: Kostelecky-Lane-Pickering, hep-th/0111123v1
sources.read: Intro and section II definitions; section III vertex/charge Ward passage; IV.A-IV.C, beta functions (28), integrated expressions (34); visual pages 9,10

sources.source_issue: Printed integrated kF expression (34) appears inconsistent with (28) on a nonzero Ricci-free kF and c=0: (28) runs it as Q^-1 while (34) leaves it constant. The campaign uses its own differential derivation, not (34). This is a local formula-consistency observation, not a claim to have audited the entire paper.

limits: No all-orders control, finite lattice matching constant, native phase, exact charged pole or experimental Lorentz bound is supplied by these sources. Search for an erratum/typo concerning KLP equation 34 did not find a relevant correction; absence of a search hit is not proof none exists.
